mod.name: Shared Galaxy
mod.description:
Opens the game straight into your Shared Galaxy room's save, so a session is one command instead of finding the right folder in the load menu.
Does nothing on its own. It reads a file the Shared Galaxy client writes just before launching the game, and deletes it after reading — every other launch behaves exactly like an unmodded game.
Changes nothing in your savegames.
Requires: SpaceHaven Mod Loader (steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3703674043)
